notes: P3-A9/a5 floor logo with local_color_match=true. Color match into the matte court paint is the headline win — the blue background of the Red Bull plate visually melts into the court color, so the wordmark and bulls look painted rather than stickered. No bright luminance halo around the perimeter on the matte court (the canonical v1 underscored case is materially better here, hence halo_presence=4). Letter edges are reasonably clean; some mild reflex but not the obvious smear seen on prior runs. The forensic 'original−clean delta' and 'original survival' panels show residual original-Melbourne wordmark energy bleeding through under the composite, which is why texture_match is 4 not 5. No jitter across motion strips. Player contact shadow on the logo is weak — feet sit on the mark without a contact-darkening cue, so player_contact_shadow=3.
